episodes.synopsis: All Alto wanted was to graduate. Next thing he knows, he has a familiar with no regard for personal space.
episodes.title: The Desperate Magician and the Imprisoned Disaster

episodes.synopsis: It's not a question if Vermeil's interested in Alto. It's a question if her demonic nature means she's interested in him or only in his mana.
